Based on the retrieved excerpts, **clause 8.2** (Doc 1) specifies the requirements for emergency preparedness. In addition to having an evacuation map posted, your emergency preparedness process must include:

| Required Element | Clause 8.2 Reference |
|------------------|----------------------|
| **Planned first-aid response** | explicitly listed |
| **Training** | explicitly listed |
| **Periodic testing and exercising of response capability** | explicitly listed |
| **Performance evaluation and revision** after tests or actual emergencies | explicitly listed |
| **Communication of duties** to workers and relevant interested parties | explicitly listed |
| **Consideration of contractors, visitors and neighbours** | explicitly listed |
| **Documented information** on the processes and response plans | explicitly listed |

Additionally, **clause 6.1.4** (Doc 2) requires that your emergency preparedness planning must:
- Integrate actions into your OH&S system processes or other business processes
- Evaluate their effectiveness
- Consider the **hierarchy of controls** and outputs of the system when planning

Your evacuation map alone satisfies only the visual communication aspect. The standard requires a comprehensive, documented, tested, and continuously improved emergency preparedness process with active worker participation (as also required by **clause 5.4**, Doc 5) covering all the elements above.
